description: This file defines the interface schema for the VoiceControl plugin API, including methods, events, data structures, and documentation for managing voice control sessions within a software project.

methods.name: configureVoice
methods.description: Configures the RDK's voice stack with various URL endpoints and device enable flags, supporting multiple protocols and configurations.

methods.name: sendVoiceMessage
methods.description: Sends a custom message payload to the Voice Server, used for context or transmitting ASR blobs.

methods.name: setVoiceInit
methods.description: Sets application metadata in the INIT message sent to the Voice Server, including capabilities and language preferences.

methods.name: voiceSessionByText
methods.description: Simulates a voice session with a transcription string for QA or automation testing.

methods.name: voiceSessionRequest
methods.description: Requests a voice session of a specified type with optional parameters such as transcription or audio file.

methods.name: voiceSessionTerminate
methods.description: Terminates an active voice session given its session ID.

methods.name: voiceSessionAudioStreamStart
methods.description: Starts a subsequent audio stream for an active voice session.

methods.name: voiceStatus
methods.description: Retrieves current status information of the voice stack, including URL configurations and device statuses.
